name: Avicenna
contribution: A preeminent philosopher and physician of the Muslim world.
image_credit: Adam Jones from Kelowna, BC, Canada · Public domain

checks.lead: Ibn Sina (c. 980 – 22 June 1037), commonly known in the West as Avicenna, was a preeminent philosopher and physician of the Muslim world. He was a seminal figure of the Islamic Golden Age, serving in the courts of various Iranian rulers, and was influential to medieval European medical and Scholastic thought. Avicenna is considered one of the greatest thinkers and medical scholars in history.
